name: compile
title: Understand a request
description: Read a request written in everyday words, in any language, and return how SpecStream understood it: what to find, the conditions every result must meet, the facts to bring back (required or optional), how many, and in what order, with the ast_hash that identifies this reading. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

name: edit_spec
title: Change what to find or bring back
description: Change a condition or a fact to bring back without rewording the request. Send the revised reading as ast with the edit operations, and get back a checked reading with a new ast_hash for the next quote. Results that already ran stay as they were.

annotations.title: Change what to find or bring back

the result's own source; a quoted no removes the result; an unconfirmed line
is delivered marked.

name: list_find_rows
title: Read the results
description: Read the results that met every condition, with the source behind each check, a page at a time; next_cursor is null on the last page. The separate possible list holds candidates with open conditions, which are not results and were not charged.

name: get_find
title: Check on a run
description: Read a run's request, progress, and what it has cost so far. After the user approves a quote, check it until the run finishes.

name: get_revisit
title: Read what a recheck found
description: Read one page of the records a recheck looked at: what still holds, what changed, and what it couldn't reach. Pass next_after as after until it is null.

name: create_spec
title: Save a request
description: Save a reviewed request as its first version so it can be rerun, shared or changed.

name: list_specs
title: List saved requests
description: List the saved requests you can open.

name: get_spec
title: Open a saved request
description: Read a saved request and its current version.

name: create_spec_link
title: Share a request as a link
description: Create a link to the wording and conditions of a saved request. It never shares results or the balance.

annotations.title: Share a request as a link

name: get_shared_spec
title: Open a shared request
description: Read a request someone shared, while their link is still on.

name: revoke_spec_link
title: Turn off a request link
description: Turn off a shared request link. The request and its results stay.

name: revise_spec
title: Save a new version
description: Save a change to a saved request as a new version, only if nobody changed it since you read it.

parent_revision_id.description: Branch from this revision of the same request. Leave it out to branch from the current head. expected_revision_id still protects the current head against concurrent edits.
parent_revision_id.title: Parent Revision Id

name: list_spec_revisions
title: Read a request's history
description: List every saved version of a request.

name: get_spec_revision
title: Open one version
description: Read one earlier version of a saved request, unchanged.

name: archive_spec
title: Archive or restore a request
description: Put a saved request away, or bring it back. Its results stay.

name: list_spec_finds
title: See every run of a request
description: List the runs each version of a saved request did.

annotations.title: See every run of a request

name: get_find_lineage
title: See where a run came from
description: Read which version of a request a run used, and the earlier run it continued.

annotations.title: See where a run came from

name: create_project
title: Create a project
description: Start a project with its own spending limit.

name: list_projects
title: List projects
description: List the projects you can open, with your role in each.

name: get_project
title: Open a project
description: Read a project, its members, their roles and their spending limits.

name: update_project
title: Update a project
description: Change a project's details, only if nobody changed them since you read them.

name: put_project_member
title: Set a member's role and limit
description: Make someone an editor or viewer of a project, with their own monthly spending limit.

annotations.title: Set a member's role and limit

name: list_project_members
title: List project members
description: List who is in a project and their roles.

name: revoke_project_member
title: Remove a project member
description: End someone's access to a project. Their work stays.

name: get_delivery
title: Open delivered results
description: Read a run's finished results with the request version and sources behind them.

name: get_find_decisions
title: See why each result qualified
description: Read each condition check on a run's results: yes, no or unsure, the value seen, and its source.

name: replay_find_decisions
title: Replay the checks
description: Reproduce a run's saved checks from the recorded evidence. No new search and no new charge.

name: get_me
title: Check spending limits
description: Read the spending limit for this connection and how much of it is left.

name: search_workspace
title: Search your work
description: Find records, lists, requests, projects, people, notes and monitors by name or text.

name: list_notifications
title: Read notifications
description: Read mentions, finished work and blocked monitors.

name: list_audit_events
title: Read the audit log
description: Read sign-ins, new keys, approved spending, exports, monitors and imports from the last 12 months.

name: get_account
title: Read the account
description: Read the account and its payment history.

name: spec_options
title: See what you can ask for
description: List the conditions and facts SpecStream can check for one kind of record.

annotations.title: See what you can ask for

name: get_find_commerce
title: Check a run's payment
description: Read what a run was charged, what it delivered, and who can open it.

name: reconcile_find_commerce
title: Recover a payment
description: Find a payment that already happened for a run instead of running the work again.

name: cancel_find
title: Stop a run
description: Ask a run in progress to stop. It keeps what it already found.

name: export_find
title: Download the results
description: Create a download link for a run's results as CSV, Excel, JSON or HTML, or KML and GeoJSON for records with places. The link works for 24 hours.

ExportFormat.description: Owned Delivery export formats, including maps from supplied coordinates.
ExportFormat.title: ExportFormat

name: share_find
title: Share results
description: Create a link to a fixed copy of a run's results that anyone with the link can open.

name: revoke_share
title: Stop sharing results
description: Turn off a shared results link.

name: get_capacity_catalog
title: Read prices
description: Read the plans, per-result rates and top-up options.

name: get_capacity_balance
title: Check the balance
description: Read the balance available for work. A balance is not permission to spend: paid work still needs the user's approval of a quote.

name: get_capacity_entitlements
title: Check what the plan includes
description: Read the account's plan, what it includes, such as schedules, CRM sync and single sign-on, and how many members it has. A feature the plan doesn't include returns plan_required with the plan that includes it.

name: claim_free_capacity
title: Claim the free start
description: Claim the one-time free balance for an eligible, verified account.

name: quote_capacity_work
title: Get a quote
description: Price the reading identified by ast_hash before anything runs. Operation find prices a new request, extend more results, add_facts more facts on results the user has, and refresh a recheck of them; the last three take parent_find_id. For an imported list, find with source_import_id and its source_row_ids fills in details or checks each row. The quote shows the most the work can cost. Nothing is spent.

name: get_capacity_quote
title: Reopen a quote
description: Read a quote and any work already approved from it.

name: authorize_capacity_work
title: Approve a quote
description: Start the work on an approved quote: its quote_id and quote_hash, the ceiling the user approved in cents as confirm_max_cents, and a stable idempotency_key. SpecStream then reads the live web and charges only for delivered results, never more than the ceiling.

name: get_capacity_request
title: Find work already started
description: Return the work started with an idempotency_key, so a retry doesn't start it twice.

name: get_capacity_execution
title: Read what a run cost
description: Read the finished work, what it cost, and your access to its results.

name: create_capacity_schedule
title: Create a monitor
description: Run a request on a schedule, hourly to yearly, within a limit per run and per period. Each run reads the live web. Rechecks cost half.

name: list_capacity_schedules
title: List monitors
description: Read your monitors and whether each is running or paused.

name: update_capacity_schedule
title: Pause, resume or delete a monitor
description: Pause, resume or delete a monitor. Missed runs are never bought later.

annotations.title: Pause, resume or delete a monitor

name: list_capacity_occurrences
title: See each monitor run
description: Read a monitor's completed, blocked and missed runs, with the reason.

name: create_capacity_refund_claim
title: Report a wrong result
description: Send charged results that don't meet the request's conditions for review and a refund.

name: get_capacity_refund_claim
title: Check a report
description: Read the status of a reported wrong result.

name: create_api_key
title: Create an API key
description: Create an API key with permissions, an expiry date and a spending limit. Ask the account owner first.

name: create_webhook
title: Add a webhook
description: Send a signed event to your URL when a run finishes, a monitor finds something new, or records are added. The signing secret is shown once.

name: delegate_access
title: Delegate a budget
description: Let a key or project run specific work within a per-run and monthly limit.

name: request_account_deletion
title: Close the account
description: Close the account. Access ends at once and the data is erased seven days later.

name: invite_project_member
title: Invite someone to a project
description: Email a project invitation with a role, a spending limit and an expiry date.

name: filter_by_area
title: Filter by map area
description: Narrow a collection to the records inside an area on the map.

name: set_schedule_delivery
title: Choose where a monitor reports
description: Choose where new and changed records go when a monitor finds them: notifications, Slack, a connected tool or a signed webhook. Nothing runs.

name: list_collections
title: List collections
description: List the imported lists and results you can open.

name: get_collection
title: Open a collection
description: Read a collection's records, columns and saved views.

name: combine_collections
title: Combine lists
description: Merge collections you own into one, keeping each record once with its sources.

name: filter_collection
title: Narrow a list
description: Keep the records you pick by ID, by source or by where they are.

name: list_views
title: List saved views
description: Read the views saved on a collection.

name: save_view
title: Save a view
description: Keep the filters, columns, sort order and map area of a collection as a personal view.

name: list_starred
title: List starred work
description: Read the requests, collections and projects you starred.

name: star_item
title: Star something
description: Star or unstar a request, collection or project so it shows in the sidebar.

name: list_notes
title: Read notes
description: Read the notes on a project or a record.

name: add_note
title: Leave a note
description: Add a note to a project or a record. Anyone you @mention gets an email.

name: resolve_note
title: Resolve a note
description: Mark a note done, or reopen it.

name: list_your_fields
title: Read your fields
description: Read the status, checkbox and text fields your team added to a collection.

name: save_your_fields
title: Add, rename or remove your fields
description: Add, rename or remove your own fields on a collection. Removing a field deletes its values.

annotations.title: Add, rename or remove your fields

name: set_your_field
title: Mark records
description: Set or clear one of your own fields on the records you choose, like a status of Called.

name: list_connections
title: List connected tools
description: List the spreadsheets, databases, CRMs and automation tools this account connected.

name: list_connection_destinations
title: Pick where records go
description: List the sheets, tables, bases and CRM objects in a connected account.

name: get_connection_columns
title: Read a destination's fields
description: Read the columns or properties a destination has, in the tool's own words. Nothing is sent.

name: save_connection_destination
title: Save a field mapping
description: Save which fact goes into which field of a destination, for every send after this one.

name: send_to_destination
title: Send records to a tool
description: Write the selected results to Google Sheets, Excel, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, Salesforce or Outlook drafts with the saved field mapping. A CRM updates the records it already has.

name: reconcile_destination_export
title: Check an uncertain send
description: Check what arrived in a destination before anything is sent twice.

name: create_destination_sync
title: Keep a tool up to date
description: Keep sending new and changed records to the same destination with the same mapping.

annotations.title: Keep a tool up to date

name: update_destination_sync
title: Start or stop sending
description: Start or stop continuous sending to a destination.

name: list_destination_syncs
title: List continuous sends
description: Read every destination that receives new records, and whether it is on.

name: list_destination_exports
title: Read what was sent
description: Read each send: where it went, how many records arrived, and which were updated or skipped.

name: list_connected_tools
title: See tools you can connect
description: List the sheets, databases, CRMs, automation and chat tools SpecStream can send to.

name: import_from_source
title: Import from a connected sheet
description: Import a Google Sheet, Excel workbook or Airtable view, and optionally check it every day for new and changed rows.

name: preview_cloud_list
title: Preview a connected sheet
description: Read the first rows and columns of a Google Sheet, Excel workbook or Airtable view before importing it.

name: list_cloud_imports
title: List linked sheets
description: Read the sheets and tables you linked, and when each was last checked.

name: update_cloud_import
title: Start or stop daily checks
description: Turn the daily check for new and changed rows on or off for a linked sheet.

name: import_csv
title: Import a CSV or Excel file
description: Bring in your own list with names, websites, places and any other columns. Nothing is researched or charged. Then quote a find with source_import_id to fill in details or check each row.

annotations.title: Import a CSV or Excel file

name: list_activity
title: Read activity
description: Read what happened across the account and its projects, and who did it.

name: get_relationships
title: See what records share
description: Group records by the values they share in a column.

name: save_relationships
title: Connect records by a column
description: Save the column that links records, such as a city, an owner or a supplier.

name: report_wrong_result
title: Report a result in a list
description: Report a charged result in a list that is wrong, within 7 days, for review and a refund.

annotations.title: Report a result in a list

name: list_request_templates
title: Start from an example
description: List example requests that already work for each kind of record. Edit one, then understand and quote it before anything runs.

name: get_collection_changes
title: See what changed
description: Compare a list with its earlier results: each changed fact, before and after, and where it was seen.
